The strongest root-cause signal is **currencyservice**: beginning at 11:24, its memory rises from about 45 MB to 121–231 MB, while CPU and sockets also increase and its p90 latency rises. At the same time, checkoutservice and frontend p90 latency increase. This fits currencyservice degradation propagating to checkout and frontend; the metrics do not establish that memory pressure itself caused the delay, since no limit or OOM data is provided.

The frontend’s “failed to retrieve ads” messages point to a possible separate ad-fetch problem, but adservice’s supplied metrics show no corresponding latency, error, or resource change. They are not enough to explain the broader latency pattern.
